purpose: Manual behavior-evaluation cases; these are not an automated model benchmark.

cases.prompt: We are changing an optional response field to required and renaming an enum value. Review compatibility.
expected_behaviors: Identify client breakage and version/deprecation options
Suggest contract tests and migration guidance

cases.prompt: A payment endpoint may be retried after timeout. Review the contract.
expected_behaviors: Check idempotency, duplicate effects, error semantics, and retry safety

cases.prompt: An API paginates records sorted by created_at only. What should be checked?
expected_behaviors: Check deterministic tie-breaking, bounded page sizes, and cursor semantics
Distinguish contract risk from confirmed exploit
